title: Flux 3 Keyframes to Video
description: FLUX 3 is Black Forest Labs' frontier video model. This endpoint builds video from a sequence of keyframes, generating the motion between each anchor point for precise control over how a shot progresses.

pricing.text: Your request will be charged at 0.17 $ per second of generated video at 720p, and 0.29 $ per second at 1080p.

inputs.name: prompt
inputs.tooltip: The text prompt describing the video you want to generate.

inputs.name: aspect_ratio
inputs.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the generated video. `auto` lets the model choose.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.tooltip: Duration of the generated video in seconds. An explicit duration is required to validate keyframe positions.

inputs.name: generate_audio
inputs.tooltip: Whether to generate audio for the video.

inputs.name: safety_tolerance
inputs.tooltip: The safety tolerance level for the generated video. 0 is the strictest and 4 is the most permissive.

inputs.name: keyframes
inputs.tooltip: Keyframe images pinned to frame positions in the generated video. Up to 10 keyframes with unique `frame_index` values. JSON. Required.
